propositions: A standing, sidecar-native per-criterion effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py) appends firing rows to an append-only ledger (runs/criterion_firings.jsonl) without git-walk cost, auto-including every criterion id present in the corpus.

The recorder computes detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later suppressed via decision='dropped' without remediation) as complementary FP/TP lenses distinct from R7's outcome-corpus metric.

The --report mode reads the committed ledger and outputs per-criterion metrics over a trailing window of tickets, with deterministic null rates when denominators are zero and all criteria auto-included.
The firing ledger is prune-immune (stored before sidecar's 50-round per-ticket retention prune takes effect) and idempotent via dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id).
Advisory criteria are automatically monitored for promotion/demotion via zero-wiring auto-inclusion and standing incremental recording, eliminating per-criterion registration overhead.
The implementation is deterministic instrumentation only (zero LLM calls, no batch eval, no new agent invocation) and integrates as a documented periodic job analogous to R7's precedent.
